- From now on, updates will come less often: the app is now stable, and new features will arrive in larger batches. Exceptions: bug fixes and security fixes will still ship as soon as they are ready
- Speed test: fast lines are no longer capped around 600 Mbit/s. The test now ends with a 500 MB then a 1 GB transfer in each direction, split over six connections at once like Ookla's app. These big files are skipped on metered connections and when they would take more than 40 seconds
- New Wi-Fi tool: Wi-Fi Aware, next to Wi-Fi Direct. It shows what your phone supports and finds the nearby phones with the tool open, with their distance when both support Wi-Fi RTT, and lets you wave at them
- SDR: tools are now named after their protocol (ADS-B, AIS, APRS, ACARS, Meteor-M) and sorted alphabetically
- SDR: the FM radio, Meshtastic and GPS receiver tools are removed
- SDR Drones: the DJI tab now comes first
